An '''apartment complex''' was sited on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the midst of the [[Battle of Argul]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nemen Ull]] entered the complex in search of a [[Unidentified Argullian child|missing Argullian child]]. However, the building was shelled by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], resulting in the destruction of the complex and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Ull.
